source_title: Microsoft Support: Feed content specifications in Partner Hub

fetch.note: A watch window News Distribution uses to say a fetch is later than usual. It is not a Microsoft schedule.

image.missing.note: Items need an image to be auto-published. News Distribution leaves an article without a featured image out of the feeds.

image.below_minimum.note: The thumbnail should be at least 640 x 360 px. The article stays in the feeds; Microsoft decides what to do with a smaller image.

image.below_recommended.note: Microsoft recommends a 1280 x 720 px thumbnail.

item.unique_id.note: Items with the same unique ID are treated as one article and skipped unless the Updated or Published date changes. News Distribution keeps the ID of an article for good.

item.updated_element.note: The Updated date is written as the Atom updated element on each item. Microsoft's page names the date; the exact element it reads was not confirmed.

feed.format.note: News Distribution writes RSS 2.0, one feed per language. The list of formats Microsoft accepts was not re-read.

feed.size.note: Each feed holds the articles of the last 7 days, at most 100. This is News Distribution's own size, not a Microsoft limit.

title.missing.note: An item without a title cannot be read, so the article is left out.

link.missing.note: An item without a public address cannot be read, so the article is left out.

partner_hub.invitation.note: Partner Hub is invitation-only. Microsoft sends an invitation code after it approves the site.
